comment: trap.c help_monster_out() 5723, 5753-5755 and 5767-5770. A level-14 Rogue wishes for the Master Key of Thievery, a magic flute and a pit trap, and lures a hostile dingo into the pit. Overtaxed by five heavy iron balls, she #invokes the key toward the dingo: invoke_untrap() calls untrap(TRUE) without could_untrap(), so help_monster_out() reaches check_capacity() (5723; #untrap itself refuses at could_untrap() 5263 for HVY_ENCUMBER). She drops the balls, plays the flute (msleeping and mfrozen set) and #untraps: untrap_prob() is nonzero, so the grasp fails and the dingo awakens (5753-5755). Three more tunes fail on the still-frozen dingo, and the next #untrap grabs it and rn2(mfrozen) lets it stir (5767-5770).
